title: alert_events
description: Channel-independent decision that a listing matched an alert filter at a significant listing appearance or material version.

listing_id.description: Listing that matched the alert filter.

filter_id.description: Alert filter that matched the listing.

detected_run_id.description: Scrape run during which this event was detected.

event_type.description: Reason a new alert event was produced.

appearance_sequence.description: Listing online appearance number, incremented only after a confirmed disappearance followed by observation.

alert_fingerprint.description: Digest of alert-relevant location, date, duration, and animal fields for deduplication.

listing_content_hash.description: Full listing content hash observed when the event was created, retained for audit comparison.

target_channels.description: Notification channels requested when the event was created.

deliver_after.description: Earliest instant provider attempts may be made, allowing quiet-hour deferral.
